_about: Business rules of X Education CRM, in one place. Both backends and the ML scripts read this file. Restart the servers (stop-all.bat, start-all.bat) after editing. Action keys are fixed (the models know them); their labels, costs and discounts can be changed.

lifecycle_stages._about: Standard CRM lifecycle (HubSpot/Salesforce style), worked out from what the learner did.
lifecycle_stages.Engaged: watched a video, read the brochure or testimonials, joined a webinar, or came back for a 2nd visit
lifecycle_stages.MQL: marketing-qualified: looked at pricing, wishlisted a course or used the chat
lifecycle_stages.SQL: sales-qualified: sent an enquiry, added to cart or started checkout

automation_minutes._about: How long after the event a follow-up is considered, and how often the automation job runs.

learning._about: The automatic learning loop. A new model replaces the old one only if it predicts the untouched control group (global_control) better in at least swap_confidence of the bootstrap resamples.

ab_testing._auto_adopt: When a test is final and an email (without a discount) clearly won, it becomes the standard information email for that audience. adoption_check_share of the audience keeps the old email, so the CRM keeps checking that the winner still wins, and switches back by itself if it does not.

global_control._about: A fixed random share of leads that never gets automatic follow-ups (no next-best-action steps, campaigns or A/B emails). It measures the CRM's total impact and is the learning loop's honest check. Standard practice (e.g. Braze global control group, 1-15%).

starting_history._about: On the first start, start-all.bat creates 6 simulated months of learners (marked 'simulated') so the dashboards and the learning loop have history. Delete it with: python ml/generate_history.py --remove
